name: Raffles Bali
insider_take: Where Balinese royalty meets modern luxury on Jimbaran's pristine clifftops
whats_special: This ultra-exclusive resort features only 32 private villas, each with its own infinity pool and butler service. Built on a dramatic 14-hectare clifftop estate, Raffles Bali offers unobstructed Indian Ocean views and direct access to a secluded white sand beach. The resort's spa treatments incorporate ancient Balinese healing rituals using ingredients sourced from the property's own organic gardens.
pro_tip: Book the clifftop dining experience at sunset - it's positioned at the perfect elevation to watch the sun dip below the horizon while enjoying world-class cuisine with uninterrupted ocean panoramas.
dont_miss: The famous Jimbaran Bay seafood markets are just minutes away, where local fishermen bring in their daily catch. Visit the nearby Uluwatu Temple (15 minutes) for traditional Kecak fire dancing performances against dramatic clifftop backdrops, or explore the hidden gem of Balangan Beach for world-class surfing and fewer crowds than neighboring Bingin.
pros: Iconic Raffles luxury service and heritage brand excellence
Prime Jimbaran location with stunning ocean views and beach access
Spacious villas with private pools and traditional Balinese architecture
World-class spa and multiple dining venues
cons: Exclusive resort atmosphere may feel formal for some guests
